map.疏散时间估算（流量法） 使用指南: Evacuation time estimation (flow method) user guide
map.估算必需疏散时间 RSET 并与可用安全疏散时间 ASET 对比，按流量法核算人: Estimate required evacuation time RSET and compare with available safe evacuation time ASET; account for personnel evacuation by the flow method, for building fire design and safe evacuation assessment.
map.估算必需疏散时间 RSET 并与可用安全疏散时间 ASET 对比: Estimate required evacuation time RSET and compare with available safe evacuation time ASET
map.性能化疏散评估中，计算必需疏散时间 RSET 并与可用安全时间 ASET 比较。: In performance-based evacuation assessment, compute required evacuation time RSET and compare with available safe time ASET.
map.RSET = 预动作 + max(流动时间, 行程时间)，ASET 来自火灾模拟: RSET = pre-action + max(flow time, travel time); ASET comes from fire simulation (smoke/temperature reaching dangerous threshold).
map.安全判据为 ASET > RSET，且需留安全系数，比值过小即判不安全。: The safety criterion is ASET > RSET, with a safety margin; too small a ratio means unsafe.
map.算例：100 人、宽 2m、流量 1.5、距离 30m、速度 1.2、预动作 3: Example: 100 people, width 2m, flow 1.5, distance 30m, speed 1.2, pre-action 30s, ASET 120s
map.：若 ASET ≤ RSET 则人员可能在危险来临前无法撤出，判定不安全；一般要: : if ASET <= RSET, personnel may fail to evacuate before danger arrives and it is judged unsafe; generally ASET/RSET >= 1.5 (with safety factor) is required. Larger margin is safer; ratio < 1 must be rectified (widen exits / shorten distance / control fire).
map.RSET 为什么取流动与行程的较大值？: Why does RSET take the larger of flow and travel time?
map.两者代表不同瓶颈：流动时间取决于出口吞吐，行程时间取决于最远点行走。实际撤离由较: They represent different bottlenecks: flow time depends on exit throughput, travel time on the farthest walking distance. Actual evacuation is decided by the slower one, so max is taken for a conservative required evacuation time.
map.ASET 来自火灾动力学模拟（如烟气层降至危险高度、温度/毒气达临界），本工具作: ASET comes from fire dynamics simulation (e.g. smoke layer drops to dangerous height, temperature/toxic gas reaching critical); this tool takes it as an external input. RSET must be clearly smaller than ASET with a safety margin to be safe.
